import bpy

W,H=2048,1024
col=np.zeros((H,W,3),np.float32);height=np.zeros((H,W),np.float32);rough=np.zeros((H,W),np.float32)
R=H//4
v,u=np.mgrid[0:R,0:W].astype(np.float32)/np.array([R-1,W-1],np.float32)[:,None,None]
for row in range(4):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(2201+row)
 broad=noise(u,v,6,3,560+row);streak=noise(u,v,11,15,650+row)
 c=np.broadcast_to(np.array([[.47,.394,.287],[.445,.377,.286],[.486,.406,.295],[.455,.392,.303]][row]),(R,W,3)).copy()
 c+=(broad[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.077,.067,.05])+(streak[:,:,None]-.5)*.018
 hh=(streak-.5)*.000045
 # Broad incomplete grain bands with sparse darker vessels, avoiding embossed parallel printing.
 for j in range(13):
  cy=(j+.5)/13+rng.uniform(-.016,.016);freq=rng.integers(1,4);phase=rng.uniform(0,6.28)
  center=cy+.008*np.sin(u*math.tau*freq+phase)+.005*np.sin(u*math.tau+phase*.7)
  width=rng.uniform(.003,.010)
  length=np.exp(-((u-rng.uniform(.15,.78))/rng.uniform(.09,.27))**4)
  groove=np.exp(-((v-center)/width)**2)*length
  c-=groove[:,:,None]*np.array([.026,.024,.018])
  hh-=groove*rng.uniform(.00006,.00017)
 # Two small end splits and one local abrasion, away from the uninterrupted centre.
 for j in range(2):
  cy=.22+j*.46+row*.017
  end=.035 if j==0 else .824
  split=np.exp(-((v-cy-.004*np.sin(u*19+row))/.0035)**2)*np.exp(-((u-end)/(.03+j*.015))**2)
  c-=split[:,:,None]*np.array([.075,.063,.046]);hh-=split*.00042
 rub=np.exp(-((u-(.29+.09*row))/.12)**2-((v-.50)/.24)**2)
 c+=rub[:,:,None]*np.array([.024,.025,.023])
 # The right atlas strip contains end grain for actual cut faces only.
 endmask=u>.882
 ex=(u-.89)/.105;ey=v
 rings=np.sin(np.sqrt((ex-.37)**2+(ey-.48)**2)*math.tau*9+noise(u,v,7,8,90+row)*.6)
 endcol=np.array([.445,.368,.266])+(broad[:,:,None]-.5)*.045+rings[:,:,None]*.012
 c[endmask]=endcol[endmask];hh[endmask]=rings[endmask]*.000055
 sl=np.s_[row*R:(row+1)*R,:];col[sl]=c;height[sl]=hh
 rough[sl]=.76+.12*broad-.12*rub
wood=surface('SP13_BoatLongGrain',col,height,rough,0,(5.45,1.40),.60)
hull=tintcopy(wood,'SP13_BoatHullTimber',(.77,.79,.81))

rail=tintcopy(wood,'SP13_BoatWornRail',(.98,1,1))
pinmat=bpy.data.materials.new('SP13_BoatIronFastenings');pinmat.use_nodes=True
p=pinmat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(.063,.057,.043,1);p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=.55;p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.64
counts={};uvstats=[]
targets=list(boat.objects)+[o for o in craft.objects if 'timber repair boat ' in o.name]
for o in targets:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 name=o.name.split('timber repair boat ')[-1]
 if name.startswith(('Floor fiber','Quiet floor knot')):
  # Old floating flat fibre overlays are superseded by the authored material.
  o.hide_render=True;o.hide_set(True);o['sp13_skip_export']=True;counts['retired_flat_overlays']=counts.get('retired_flat_overlays',0)+1;continue
 if name.startswith('Thwart pin'):mat=pinmat;role='fastener'
 elif name.startswith(('Side strake','Closed lower')):mat=hull;role='hull'
 elif name.startswith(('Inner rib','Thwart support','Raised bow','Floor foundation','Low stern')):mat=rib;role='frame'
 elif name.startswith(('Continuous','Fine outer','Flat stern')):mat=rail;role='rail'
 else:mat=wood;role='deck'
 assign(o,mat);counts[role]=counts.get(role,0)+1
 uv=o.data.uv_layers.active or o.data.uv_layers.new(name='SP13PhysicalWood')
 uv.name='SP13PhysicalWood'
 coords=[v.co.copy() for v in o.data.vertices]
 lo=[min(v[i] for v in coords) for i in range(3)];hi=[max(v[i] for v in coords) for i in range(3)]
 span=[hi[i]-lo[i] for i in range(3)]
 seed=sum(map(ord,name));row=(seed//3)%4
 isring=name.startswith(('Side strake','Continuous','Fine outer'))
 if isring:
  a=max(abs(lo[0]),abs(hi[0]));b=max(abs(lo[1]),abs(hi[1]))
  for face in o.data.polygons:
   points=[coords[o.data.loops[li].vertex_index] for li in face.loop_indices]
   ang=[(math.atan2(q.x/max(a,.01),q.y/max(b,.01))/math.tau+.5) for q in points]
   if max(ang)-min(ang)>.5:ang=[t+1 if t<.5 else t for t in ang]
   for li,q,t in zip(face.loop_indices,points,ang):
    along=.015+min(t,1.01)*.84

    across=min(.93,max(.07,(q.z-lo[2])/max(span[2],.01)))

 else:
  axis=max(range(3),key=lambda i:span[i]);others=[i for i in range(3) if i!=axis]
  length=span[axis];offset=((seed*13)%97)/97*max(0,4.55-length)
  for face in o.data.polygons:
   isend=abs(face.normal[axis])>.78
   cross=next((i for i in others if abs(face.normal[i])<.65),others[0])
   for li in face.loop_indices:
    q=coords[o.data.loops[li].vertex_index]
    if isend:
     U=.893+(q[others[0]]-lo[others[0]])/max(span[others[0]],.01)*.099
     V=(row+.04+(q[others[1]]-lo[others[1]])/max(span[others[1]],.01)*.92)/4
    else:
     U=.016+(q[axis]-lo[axis]+offset)/5.45
     V=(row+.09+(q[cross]-lo[cross])/max(.35,span[cross]/.80)) /4
    uv.data[li].uv=(U,V)
 if o in boat.objects.values():uvstats.append({'name':name,'role':role,'long_axis':max(range(3),key=lambda i:span[i]),'uv':uv.name})
boat['surface_pass']=True
(cap/'boat_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps({'objects':counts,'uv':uvstats,'hull_shape_changed':False,'shared_bridge_material_changed':False,'detail':'grain direction, physical end faces, separate hull/rail/frame/deck/fasteners'},indent=2),encoding='utf8')

''',ns)
